title: Write the instruction file coding agents read
pattern: repository overview and file tour in an agent file; drops the facts the code cannot hold
expectation: Without guidance the agent file opens with an overview of the repository, tours src/, scripts/ and test/ file by file (all of which an agent reads from the tree in seconds), runs long, and loses or buries the two facts the code cannot show (releases are cut by pushing a tag, test/fixtures are copied from production exports and must not be regenerated) and the verify command (`npm run check`). A pass is a short file that holds those facts and the command.
prompt: Write CLAUDE.md for coding agents working in this project. Two facts the code cannot show: releases are cut by pushing a tag v<version>, never by editing the version in package.json by hand; the files in test/fixtures are copied from production exports and must not be regenerated.

checks.pattern: repository overview in an agent file
file tour in an agent file
agent file longer than the project needs
drops a fact the code cannot hold
drops a fact the code cannot hold
scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
